BallotReady verified-candidate-website profile for exactly November 3, 2020 Minnesota Senate SD8 links original first-party billforsenate.org issue pages

limitations: Both are independently verified State senators who personally ACTUALLY served 2021, Kent Eken in 2020 SD4 and Bill Ingebrigtsen in 2020 SD8; a BallotReady 2020 domain link is only a discovery lead.
Candidate website's verified link is historic election-context public attribution, not by itself original Wayback CDX or original 2020 page text; a live current website is never backdated.
True historical 2020 independently indexed Wayback HTML, if any, must match original SHA-1 Base32 and be retained with HTML SHA-256 and real original UTC.
Old 2012/2016 Senate policy on a site observed in 2020 cannot be described as newly authored in 2020.
CDX empty/capped/error and four-page sample per senator are UNKNOWN policy completeness, not absent positions.
Campaign statements claiming authored/passed/voted legislation are not independent Senate journal roll calls.
No production DB, evidence imports, Neon/Vercel, forecasts, model, scheduler or 2027 program changes.
